title: Databases & Data-Intensive Systems
blurb: Storage engines, replication, partitioning, transactions, consensus, batch and stream processing - a chapter-by-chapter companion to Designing Data-Intensive Applications, plus practical databases for ML engineers.
sources: Martin Kleppmann, Designing Data-Intensive Applications (O'Reilly, 2017), ch. 1-12
Malkov & Yashunin, Efficient and robust approximate nearest neighbor search using HNSW graphs (2016)

modules.title: 1. Reliable, Scalable, Maintainable Applications
modules.summary: Faults vs failures, describing load with load parameters, response-time percentiles, SLOs, and maintainability.

lessons.title: Reliability and maintainability
Scalability: load parameters, percentiles and SLOs

modules.title: 2. Data Models & Query Languages
modules.summary: Relational vs document vs graph, schema-on-read vs schema-on-write, declarative queries, Cypher, SPARQL, Datalog.

lessons.title: Relational vs document models
Graph models and query languages

modules.title: 3. Storage & Retrieval
modules.summary: Hash indexes, SSTables and LSM-trees, Bloom filters, B-trees and WAL, OLTP vs OLAP, column stores, star schemas.

lessons.title: Log-structured storage: hash indexes, SSTables, LSM-trees
B-trees, write-ahead logs and the LSM vs B-tree trade-off
OLTP vs OLAP, warehouses and column-oriented storage

modules.title: 4. Encoding & Evolution
modules.summary: JSON, Protocol Buffers, Avro, backward/forward compatibility, and data flow through databases, RPC and messages.

lessons.title: Encoding formats and schema evolution
Modes of data flow: databases, REST/RPC, message passing

modules.title: 5. Replication
modules.summary: Leader/follower, sync vs async, replication-lag anomalies, multi-leader, leaderless quorums, conflicts and CRDTs.

lessons.title: Single-leader replication and replication lag
Multi-leader and leaderless replication, quorums
Detecting concurrent writes: LWW, version vectors, CRDTs

modules.title: 6. Partitioning
modules.summary: Key-range vs hash partitioning, hot spots, secondary indexes, rebalancing strategies and request routing.

lessons.title: Partitioning key-value data and hot spots
Secondary indexes, rebalancing and request routing

modules.title: 7. Transactions
modules.summary: ACID, read committed, snapshot isolation and MVCC, lost updates, write skew, phantoms, serial execution, 2PL, SSI.

lessons.title: ACID, read committed and snapshot isolation
Lost updates, write skew and phantoms
Serializability: serial execution, 2PL and SSI

modules.title: 8. The Trouble with Distributed Systems
modules.summary: Partial failures, unreliable networks, timeouts, unreliable clocks, process pauses, fencing tokens, Byzantine faults.

lessons.title: Partial failures and unreliable networks
Unreliable clocks and process pauses
Truth, majorities, fencing tokens and Byzantine faults

modules.title: 9. Consistency & Consensus
modules.summary: Linearizability, CAP, causality, Lamport clocks, total order broadcast, 2PC, Raft/Paxos and ZooKeeper.

lessons.title: Linearizability and the CAP theorem
Ordering, causality, Lamport clocks and total order broadcast
Distributed transactions, 2PC and consensus

modules.title: 10. Batch Processing
modules.summary: The Unix philosophy, MapReduce and HDFS, reduce-side and map-side joins, dataflow engines and Spark.

lessons.title: From Unix pipes to MapReduce
Batch joins and dataflow engines

modules.title: 11. Stream Processing
modules.summary: Message brokers vs logs, Kafka, change data capture, event sourcing, windows, stream joins and exactly-once.

lessons.title: Message brokers and partitioned logs
Databases and streams: CDC and event sourcing
Processing streams: time, windows, joins, fault tolerance

modules.title: 12. The Future of Data Systems
modules.summary: Data integration, derived data, unbundling the database, end-to-end correctness and doing the right thing.

lessons.title: Data integration and unbundling databases
Aiming for correctness and doing the right thing

modules.title: 13. Practical Databases for ML Engineers
modules.summary: PostgreSQL essentials, indexes in practice, Redis, vector databases (HNSW/IVF), choosing a database, interview playbook.

lessons.title: PostgreSQL essentials and indexes in practice
Redis and vector databases
Choosing a database and the system-design playbook
